normative_extracts.quote: Paint walks the layout tree in stacking order to produce a list of display items, which rasterization then converts into bitmap tiles on worker threads.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Main thread records draw ops via Skia/CoreGraphics; compositor worker threads rasterize 256x256 or 512x512 tiles into GPU memory.

production_failures.symptom: Checkerboarding (blank tiles) during fast mobile scrolling
production_failures.root_cause: Expensive SVG filters, large box-shadows, or blur radii exceed the tile rasterization budget per vsync.
production_failures.mitigation: Simplify blur/shadow radii, rasterize static vectors to bitmaps, or isolate animated regions onto their own layer.

production_failures.symptom: Full-viewport repaint on a 1px hover border change
production_failures.root_cause: A child shares a backing layer with a large scrolling container without paint containment.
production_failures.mitigation: Apply contain: paint or promote the animated element so invalidation stays local.
